root_goal_boundary.immediate_branch: Construct the independent positive antenna DPA_P(c) for some 0.0189 < c < 0.019.
root_goal_boundary.ceiling: Closing this card and LTRAD would concern only the contemplated small zero-free strip near Re(s)=1. It would not prove RH without a new amplifier.

theorem_passport.source_and_mask: Every ordinary prime in [Y exp(-1/5), Y exp(1/5)]; no prime powers and no post-frequency mask.
theorem_passport.base_vector: The fixed nonnegative nodal-hat probability from HT-HAT, with profile phi(u)=(1-|u|/(1/5)) exp((49/100)u).
theorem_passport.comparison_vector: The full nearest-prime logarithmic Voronoi probability for the same nodes and profile.
theorem_passport.short_vector: Delete both half-cell shares of every physical consecutive-prime edge g>Y^(163/1000), then renormalize once; the choice is independent of t.
theorem_passport.continuous_reference: The probability nu with density phi/int(phi) on [-1/5,1/5].
theorem_passport.quantifiers: For every sufficiently large admissible half-integer Y and every real t, or every dyadic T, in the explicitly stated bands.
theorem_passport.normalization: All full vectors are probabilities. The deleted short vector is renormalized by its own remaining mass; the resulting normalization change is charged to the deleted mass.
theorem_passport.resolution: Continuum in t, not a sampled grid.
theorem_passport.target_floor: P_Y(t) >= -Y^(-19/1000) on [Y^(1/100),Y^(50/33)], with asymptotic exponent slack used in downstream adapters.
theorem_passport.relation_to_sharp_four_cycle: The proposed CA4 input is a fixed-weight, centered, translated-window fourth moment with an allowed Y^(1/10) loss. It is neither the project's arbitrary-coefficient sharp four-cycle statement nor implied by that branch's bookkeeping.
theorem_passport.trust_labels: Published inputs and proved adapters are separated from the open CA4 arithmetic estimate and from finite FLOAT-SCOUT evidence.

proved_targets_to_audit.hat_voronoi_transfer: Uniform l1/Fourier distance O(Y^(-77/100+epsilon)) between normalized full hat and full Voronoi vectors.

retuned_transition.statement: The normalized full hat transform differs from the normalized continuum transform by O(Y^(-309/16250+epsilon)) for |t|<=Y^(1049/1250).

open_candidate.name: CA4(163/1000,1/10)
open_candidate.definition: Let R_Y(t)=muhat_Y,short(t)-nuhat(t). For every overlapping dyadic T covering [Y^(1049/1250),Y^(50/33)], prove int_T^(2T) |R_Y(t)|^4 dt << T Y^(-2q+1/10+o(1)), q=2787/3250.
open_candidate.adapter: Because |R_Y'|=O(1), a point with |R_Y|>=Y^(-c) contributes Omega(Y^(-5c)) to one containing dyadic fourth moment. CA4 gives the uniform exponent c_out=(2q-50/33-1/10)/5=10717/536250=0.019985... > 0.019.
open_candidate.first_unproved_edge: A translated-kernel fourth-moment estimate for the raw retained atomic transform; equivalently, after the negligible continuum transform is restored, a gap-weighted balanced-semiprime product discrepancy at physical product resolution Y^2/T.
open_candidate.why_not_target_renaming: CA4 controls positive as well as negative peaks and is strictly stronger than the one-sided floor, but it is averaged, fixed-weight, centered, and permits a fixed Y^(1/10) excess over the atomic diagonal.

fast_falsifiers.abstract_half_grid: Fails asymptotically: an odd half-grid has a constant-width antipodal peak despite matching local geometry and good ordinary L2 energy.
fast_falsifiers.prime_density_odd_integer_model: Fails: the existing exact-log coherent odd-integer construction has no long-edge tail yet violates CA4.
fast_falsifiers.coefficient_blind_large_sieve: Fails: the standard semiprime mean-value theorem pays the conductor loss Y^2/T, whose exponent ranges from 1.1608 down to 16/33, far above the allowed 1/10.
fast_falsifiers.absolute_near_product_count: Fails: taking absolute values destroys the translated-kernel cancellation among unequal atomic products and retains the same conductor loss.
fast_falsifiers.finite_evidence: Licensed only as a bounded diagnostic on the four frozen HT-HAT vectors and their already frozen controls; no new centers or asymptotic promotion.

decision_rule.success: A proof of CA4 with every mask, normalization, dyadic endpoint, and epsilon loss preserved closes the remaining HT-HAT high band and hence supplies DPA_P(c) for every fixed c<0.019.
decision_rule.failure: A genuine actual-prime asymptotic counterexample to CA4 prunes this sufficient route but does not refute the weaker one-sided HT-HAT floor.
decision_rule.stop: Do not enlarge the finite-Y ladder. Stop at an exact literature applicability verdict and the first unsigned/signed estimate not supplied by known theorems.
